en.headline: British transit passenger arrested with 35 kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport
en.dek: A 19-year-old man arriving from Bangkok and bound for London was stopped on Monday; the drugs in two suitcases are valued at about HK$8.2 million and he appears in court today.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it arrested a 19-year-old British man on Monday after finding about 35 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in two check-in suitcases at Hong Kong International Airport.

The passenger arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, and was preparing to transit to London. Officers discovered 64 packages of the suspected drugs during clearance. The estimated market value is about HK$8.2 million.
The man was charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The case is scheduled to be mentioned at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday.

Customs said it would continue to apply risk assessment to passengers from high-risk regions and reminded the public not to carry controlled items for others. Trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 英籍過境男旅客行李藏35公斤懷疑大麻花被捕
zh.dek: 19歲男子由曼谷抵港擬轉飛倫敦，兩個行李箱檢獲64包懷疑大麻花，市值約820萬元，今日西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，周一在香港國際機場拘捕一名19歲英國籍過境男旅客，在其兩個寄艙行李箱內檢獲約35公斤懷疑大麻花。
該名男子由泰國曼谷飛抵本港，準備轉機前往英國倫敦。關員清關時發現64包懷疑毒品，估計市值約820萬港元。
男子被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件定於周三在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續重點檢查高風險地區旅客，並提醒市民切勿協助運送受管制物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
